notes.title: DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters is available NOW!
notes.content:
Influenced by cultures from across the world, DE-EXIT invites players to explore the importance of life, death, and the afterlife. In the Plane of Memory, players will uncover secrets beyond the veil and find out what awaits beyond. Embark on a heartwarming ode to life, encounter friends to guide you along the journey, and evade loose-jointed foes that wish to stop you in your tracks. Traverse harsh and cold environments, and find comfort in the warmth of the Nexus — the last safe haven. 

With a focus on single-player cinematic story-telling, DE-EXIT will challenge players to hone their skills in stealth and analyze their surroundings to solve puzzles in order to avoid the undead skeletons that occupy the world. Although players enter the world as a mere skeleton, they will soon find themselves a savior, decorated in armor that signifies their journey through the afterlife.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41245420/d42c6c349061b8b580cc651e800b03edcd504d84.jpg[/img]

[i]“Death is so often depicted negatively in the media, and we wanted to offer a new insight on the matter and to invite players to view death from a perspective that is not explored as often. The development of DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters has been shaped by people from various backgrounds and cultures, and we hope players will see and appreciate this throughout the story. We hope players will love DE-EXIT as much as we loved creating it.”  [/i]

- Julien Gatumel Fernandez, Narrative Designer at SandBloom Studios

notes.title: DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters Pre-Release Stream
notes.content:
You are already excited to play DE-EXIT? You can’t wait to experience our cinematic adventure? Well, it’s just one more day until the release of DE-EXIT – Eternal Matters and if the anticipation is too big to handle, we have something special for you: a pre-release stream! 

We will take you through the start of the game, show you some never seen before footage and talk about the game. So, swing by, get a preview of the game and ask any questions you might have. We are looking forward to seeing you on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/handygames_official]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_UBm3QXie6o]YouTube[/url] at 19:00 CET.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41245420/b80da271ca99e1b2b88fa331610ca12ce6e7c9f3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters is part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters is part of the Steam Next Fest - February Edition. So, for the first time you will be able to dive into the Plane of Memory and get to experience a small part of the mysterious world of this puzzle platformer with the playable demo.

While playing through the prologue you will get to explore the afterlife, solve intricate puzzles and feel your heart beat faster while hiding from enemies in the first stealth sections.

The demo is available from 6th to the 13th of February!
